correctness.rationale: Full-branch IID coding and product Lebesgue stationarity yield the center Markov kernel. Exact character transitions confine odd frequencies to a nearest-neighbor valuation walk with absorbing boundary; Catalan return enumeration gives all covariances. Finite variance, generating-function cusp and critical square-root correction follow analytically. For \(a>1/4\) a bounded Poisson solution and standard ergodic martingale CLT give the Gaussian conclusion. The standalone program passed 600 rational transition checks, 136 rational Poisson checks, 204 finite-variance checks, symbolic generating identity checks and independent finite numerical diagnostics, none misrepresented as proof.

The 2024 critical paper includes exact reflection-principle walk transitions, a strong conceptual precursor that does not itself state the Fourier-mode coefficient family, parameter-dependent Green–Kubo cusp, or finite-time variance. Linear-coordinate correlations and periodic-fiber results do not directly imply the Fourier-harmonic formula; a linear-coordinate observable combines infinitely many odd harmonics. value.rationale: The zero-center-Lyapunov parameter is a natural structural boundary in the published heterochaos model; smooth Fourier center observables are canonical probes. The exact all-lag correlation spectrum, sharp parameter cusp of integrated variance, nontrivial critical -4 sqrt(2N/pi) finite-time correction, and contracting-regime joint CLT distinguish genuine mechanisms beyond standard mixing-rate results. They provide quantitative tests of transport and temporal memory across the center transition.
